note: RFC 1334 Section 2.2.2: "The Identifier field MUST be copied from the Identifier field of the Authenticate-Request which caused this reply." Rejudged statically at HEAD; the bodies are unchanged. TestPAPRequestEmitsEvent asserts 0x42 on Ack and TestPAPRejectWritesNak asserts 0x77 on Nak, so a hardcoded value goes red on the first-reply path. TestPAPReanswersAfterAuthentication drives handleFrame in AckSent and Opened and asserts replies 0x5a, 0x5b, 0x5c, so a cached initial Identifier in reanswerPAP goes red. Its accept-only session is sufficient: a rejected session ends through s.fail, so the Nak has no reanswer path here. Doc comments in rfc1334_pap_test.go still cite pap.go:123, 129 and 138, which no longer name WritePAPAck, WritePAPNak or the Identifier copy.
